# Grant access
{: .no_toc }

Give a person access to an app.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `ACX-02` |
| **Route** | `/admin/users/:userId/access/grant` · deep link `substratal://admin/users/:userId/access/grant` |
| **Where** | Administration › Users |
| **Who can use it** | entitlements.manage or app owner (own app) |
| **Kind** | form |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (MVP) |
| **On Linux** | `AdwDialog` with `AdwPreferencesGroup` |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| App | select | body.application_id | app owners see only their apps | AdwComboRow |
| Type | radio-group | body.source purchase \ | trial \ | GtkCheckButton group |
| Order ID | text-field | body.order_id | required feel for purchase | AdwEntryRow |
| Starts | date-time | body.starts_at | default now | GtkCalendar in popover |
| Ends | date-time | body.ends_at | optional; required for trial | GtkCalendar in popover |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Grant | `POST /users/{id}/entitlements (Idempotency-Key, required)` | 201 → row Active. 409 entitlement_already_exists → "Already has access — view it". A platform-managed row doesn't block a grant (they coexist). |
